title: Objective detail: silent re-poll keeps last-good snapshot — page no longer collapses to top every 5s
description: Post-R4 polish on audited R4 HEAD 908da6d, vs integration BASE 07f22db. Operator-reported defect: the Objective Detail page jumped to top on every 5s poll. Root cause: the cockpit fetch effect in ObjectiveDetail.tsx (deps [biz,id,tick,polTick]) ran an UNCONDITIONAL setSt({kind:loading}) on every effect re-run — each 5s polTick produced one render of the loading skeleton, collapsing document height below scrollY so the browser clamped scroll to 0, then content restored. Reproduced live (scrollY 2111→0 at first poll, document height 2831→720 for ~30ms with skeleton rendered). Fix: new pure pollGate(prev,biz,id) in objectiveLoop.ts — 'keep' when prev is ready for THIS objective/business, 'loading' on first fetch or foreign-identity prev (fail-closed contract preserved), 'no-business' when no business selected; the effect applies it in the setSt updater so silent refetches keep the last-good snapshot. Vitest block (4 tests) proves keep/loading/no-business semantics; new e2e spec #9 'polling preserves scroll position' covers two full 5s poll cycles end-to-end (non-harness evidence). Verified on the live stack: scrollY held 2111 across 15s of polling. 90-scenario vitest + 9 e2e specs green; tsc clean; production build clean. Scope: objectiveLoop.ts, ObjectiveDetail.tsx, root test file (documented tooling exception), e2e spec; zero backend/authority changes; no new deps.
